description: This file defines the TeleReporterEmitter class, which implements the ReporterV2 interface for reporting test events in Playwright's test framework. It handles serialization of test suite, test case, step, and result data, and communicates via a message sink with JSON-encoded events. It also manages attachments, errors, and output streams.

classes.name: TeleReporterEmitter
classes.description: Implements a test reporter that emits serialized test events through a message sink, supporting features like pausing, step tracking, and attachment serialization.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the reporter, which is 'v2'.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Serializes and reports the test configuration details.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Initializes reporting for a test suite, signaling the start of the testing process.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a test and assigns a unique ID.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles pausing a test, recording error counts, and sending the pause event.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Signals the end of a test, serializes result data, and cleans up attachment/error count maps.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a test step, assigning an ID, and emitting an event.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a test step, sending step completion info and attachments.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Reports a test error.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles stdout output during tests.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles stderr output during tests.

methods.name: _onStdIO
methods.description: Internal method to process stdout/stderr chunks and send messages.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Signals the end of the entire test run, sending final results.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates whether the reporter prints to standard IO; returns false.

methods.name: _serializeConfig
methods.description: Serializes the test configuration into JSON format.

methods.name: _serializeProject
methods.description: Serializes project details for reporting.

methods.name: _serializeProjectUseOptions
methods.description: Serializes 'use' options for a project.

methods.name: _serializeSuite
methods.description: Serializes a suite, including nested entries.

methods.name: _serializeTest
methods.description: Serializes individual test case data.

methods.name: _serializeResultStart
methods.description: Serializes the start of a test result.

methods.name: _serializeResultEnd
methods.description: Serializes the end of a test result, including errors and attachments.

methods.name: _sendNewAttachments
methods.description: Sends new attachments for a test result.

methods.name: _serializeAttachments
methods.description: Converts attachments to JSON format, encoding binary data as base64 when appropriate.

methods.name: _serializeStepStart
methods.description: Serializes the start of a test step.

methods.name: _serializeStepEnd
methods.description: Serializes the end of a test step, including errors and attachments.

methods.name: _relativeAnnotationLocations
methods.description: Adjusts annotation locations relative to project directory.

methods.name: _relativeLocation
methods.description: Converts absolute locations to relative paths based on rootDir.

methods.name: _relativePath
methods.description: Converts absolute file paths to paths relative to the project's root directory.

ctags.name: resultId
ctags.pattern: /^    const resultId = (result as any)[this._idSymbol] as string;$/
